title: Enhancing Fairness through Reweighting: A Path to Attain the Sufficiency Rule

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the sufficiency gap (ΔSuf) across racial sub-groups (e.g., Black vs. Asian, African American vs. Caucasian) in classification tasks using the Toxic comments and COMPAS datasets.
Calculating the sufficiency gap (ΔSuf) across male and female sub-groups in classification tasks using the CelebA and Adult datasets.
